description: This file defines the Reward model class for the Customer Account namespace in the OpenCart system. It provides methods to add, delete, and retrieve reward points data related to customers based on orders. The class interacts with the database to manage reward points records.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Represents the reward points functionality for customer accounts, including adding, deleting, and retrieving reward data.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Adds a reward entry for a specific customer and order with a description and points.

methods.name: deleteReward
methods.description: Deletes reward entries for a customer, optionally filtering by order ID.

methods.name: deleteRewardByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes reward entries associated with a specific order ID where points are negative.

methods.name: getRewards
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reward entries for a customer, with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalRewards
methods.description: Returns the total number of reward entries for a customer.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Calculates and returns the sum of reward points for a customer.
